fixes.explanation: That's the one, friend. The psalm says, "Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments." Notice who gets the blessing. The psalm names the man who fears the LORD.

Hesitating is me at the oven door, friend, wondering if the batch is done. But that's not what this verse says about him. The psalm says he "…greatly delights in His commandments." (Psalm 112:1). That word is delights.

Ha, spending it all on yourself is a tempting plan, friend. But the psalm describes someone else. It says, "It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely…" (Psalm 112:5). His money goes out to others, not just to himself.

You got it, friend. The psalm says, "He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD." The psalm doesn't say he knows the news ahead of time. It says his heart is trusting in the LORD.
That's right, friend. The psalm says, "He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor…" Scattered, like seed tossed out by the handful. This man gives his gifts wide.
